name: @dsh-forge/core
description: DSH Forge 可审计发行版基础工具链

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron .
scripts.build: pnpm run build:desktop-services && pnpm run build:desktop-layer && pnpm run build:toolchain && pnpm run build:core
scripts.build:core: tsx scripts/clean-build-output.ts dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsx scripts/rewrite-emitted-requires.ts
scripts.build:desktop-services: pnpm --filter @dsh-forge/desktop-services build && pnpm --filter @dsh-forge/profile-toolchain build && pnpm --filter @dsh-forge/desktop-services-local build
scripts.test:desktop-services-local: pnpm run build:desktop-layer && pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime-services.test.ts tests/full-package-ota.test.ts tests/desktop-upgrade-helper.test.ts tests/desktop-upgrade-restart-receipt.test.ts tests/desktop-upgrade-offer.test.ts tests/desktop-upgrade-coordinator.test.ts tests/desktop-upgrade-remote.test.ts
scripts.test:node: pnpm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:desktop-layer && pnpm run build:desktop-services && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:desktop-layer && oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig tsconfig.json apps packages tools scripts tests
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check && pnpm run boundaries:check && pnpm run profile:resolve && pnpm run profile:verify && pnpm run catalog:verify && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run docs:build
